title: Clause-level citation
body: Every verdict cites the exact policy clause, its ID, and page number. Explainability is the product.

title: Genuine Indian-language support
body: Real code-mixing and vernacular input via Sarvam AI, not a translated English UI.

title: Closed reimbursement loop (test/mock mode)
body: Approval triggers a simulated payout (mock RazorpayX) and writes the full queued → processed audit trail — no real money moves.

title: Risk scoring, not binary
body: A composite score shows how risky and why, instead of a simple yes or no.
